text:
Taylor: Quick note- noticing host-side p99 lift after kernel-selector tweak in canary.
Imani: Saw that too. Profiling shows more time in framing/parse and grpc writev smallcalls.
Marco: Small flame: parse_request (~38%), stream_framer (~15%), grpc_writev_small (~17%), kernel_dispatch (~30%).
Taylor: Selector change shouldn't affect framing. What did PR change?
Imani: It added early-close of batching window for affinity. That seems to split streams earlier and increases small writes.
Rui: Packet captures show ~2.4x increase in frames per short-request. Also kv cache hit-rate drops slightly.
Taylor: Can we toggle the new flag off? Which flag name?
Imani: --enable-selector-affinity (default true). Flip to false restores baseline p99 in our quick test.
Marco: Proposed immediate fix: add a framer hysteresis when small_write_ratio>0.12 to extend coalesce window by 5ms and emit metric runtime.small_write_ratio.
Taylor: Good low-risk step. Also add tenant-level alerts since short-prompt tenants hit worse.
DeployBot: Rolling canary: framer-hysteresis-v1 at 6876543230 by Imani.
Rui: After 3min: p99 improved ~4ms, small_write_ratio down from 0.19 to 0.08, kv hit-rate recovered.
Imani: I'll open the PR with tests for kv-key invariance and add dashboard panels for small_write_ratio and frames_per_request.
Taylor: Long-term: update selector cost model to account for downstream framing/syscall cost. For now keep affinity rollout paused.
Marco: Adding a perf job across fleet overnight to be safe.
Taylor: Thanks team. Close after PR + perf pass.
